name: Sorcier ~Rokunin no Majutsushi~
original_name: Sorcier～ソルスィエ～ 6人の魔術師
source:
I was awakened by the same voice as always, but I was no longer the same me that I had been. It was like any other day... except I had turned into a cat!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE034519.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我和往常一样被同一个声音唤醒，但我不再是从前的我了。就像平常的一天……除了我变成了一只猫！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE034519.html]DLsite English[/url]]
